problem.title: Segment Sums
problem.statementMarkdown: The linked list contains integer values separated by zero nodes. Return a new list with the sum of each nonempty segment, including segments at either end. Consecutive zero separators create no segment. A segment whose sum is zero still creates a zero node.

examples.explanation: The segments [1, 2] and [4] sum to 3 and 4.
Consecutive separators add no segment; [-1, 1] still creates zero.
An empty list creates no segments.

constraints.text: Each nonempty segment sum fits a signed 32-bit integer.
